verdict.rationale: OpenRouter docs describe account-wide privacy settings to block providers that train on data, restrict by data policy, and enterprise in-region processing, which functions as an opt-out of certain data use — but this is about model-provider data policies, not telemetry on OpenRouter's own platform. Community commentary directly disputes the robustness of these guarantees ('No ZDR. No dice', 'no true guarantees of ZDR/privacy/data sovereignty', and confusion over the ZDR-only toggle's actual coverage).
